en: Black-and-white photograph of an ornate Catholic chapel interior showing the richly decorated altar that houses the relics of St. Peter Canisius. The scene includes a marble altar with lace cloth, tall candlesticks, vases of flowers, a central crucifix, and a large religious painting above depicting the Virgin Mary with child and saints, set within an arched niche. Decorative inscriptions frame the arch.
